title: Native Ringed Restriction Derived Hom
statement: For continuous restriction along an equivalence inducing equivalences on slices, suppose the corresponding module restriction is an equivalence and both sites admit the indicated additive sheafification and derived categories. Restriction of derived internal Hom(L,M) is isomorphic to derived internal Hom of the two restricted objects. The derived-category universes may differ. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-hom], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image].

proof.text: choose a complex representing L and a K-injective complex representing M. An exact additive equivalence preserves K-injectives. Compute the two derived Hom objects using these representatives, restrict their Hom complex using the ordinary restriction comparison, and use the localization factorization of the derived functor. The site-object, site-arrow, coefficient and derived universes remain independent.

theorem derivedHomRestriction
    {C : Type c} {D : Type d} [Category.{vc} C] [Category.{vd} D]
    {K : GrothendieckTopology C} {J : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (F : C ⥤ D) [Functor.IsContinuous F K J]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c d vc vd r})
    (hF : ∀ X : C, (Over.post (X := X) F).IsEquivalence)
    [(restrictModules.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R).IsEquivalence]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasSheafify K AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [K.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, d, vd} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, c, vc}
      (restrictedCommRing.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R))]
    (L M : DerivedCategory (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, d, vd} R)) :
    let T := restrictModules.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R
    let S := restrictedCommRing.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R
    Nonempty (T.mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{d, vd, max c vc r, w} J R).obj (op L, M)) ≅
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, vc, max d vd r, w'} K S).obj
          (op (T.mapDerivedCategory.obj L), T.mapDerivedCategory.obj M))
